# ASEPO

> > ASEPO is a professional organization advancing safety standards for special effects in entertainment, focusing on NFPA 140/160 compliance, pyrotechnics, and theatrical fog/haze safety.

The American Special Effects Pyrotechnic Operators organization works with the State Fire Marshal Special Effects Advisory Committee (SEAC) and ESTA to establish industry safety protocols. ASEPO provides technical resources including safety data sheets for fog fluids and guidance on fire effects compliance with NFPA standards.

## Key Topics

- NFPA 140 (Standard on Pyrotechnic Special Effects)
- NFPA 160 (Flame Effects Before an Audience)
- NFPA 1123 & 1126 (Fireworks standards)
- State Fire Marshal Special Effects Advisory Committee (SEAC)
- Entertainment Services & Technology Association (ESTA)
- Theatrical fog and haze safety
- Pyrotechnic safety standards
- Special effects in film production
- Safety data sheets (SDS) for fog fluids
- COVID-19 protocols for entertainment industry
- Fire effects compliance
- Entertainment industry safety
- Professional special effects operators

## Getting Started

- [ASEPO - Home](https://asepo.org/): ASEPO homepage - special effects org for NFPA 140/160 standards
- [ASEPO - Contact ASEPO](https://asepo.org/contact): Contact information for ASEPO in Studio City, California

## Safety Standards & Protocols

- [ASEPO - Covid19 Protocols](https://asepo.org/Covid19Protocols): COVID-19 return-to-work protocols for film production & special effects
- [ASEPO - Fog & Covid 19](https://asepo.org/FogCovid): Theatrical fog safety guidance during COVID-19 per EPA/OSHA standards

## Technical Reference

- [ASEPO - Fog Fluid SDS's](https://asepo.org/FogFluidSDS): Safety data sheets for fog/haze fluids from Antari, Chauvet, Froggy's
